snippet.title: Hand of Hexes trailer
snippet.description:
Hand of Hexes is a deck-builder and tower defense game where you control the enemies' paths by constructing deadly mazes – all while managing the challenge of towers that only shoot one way. Perfect your deck with unique towers and magical spells that boost your defenses or slay your enemies! 
Wishlist it now on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238220/Hand_of_Hexes/
